carousels.title: The Los Angeles friendship playbook
carousels.sub: Even if everyone you meet is “so slammed right now.”

slides.h: Go to the same thing twice
slides.box: Regulars become friends. Strangers stay strangers.
slides.body: Pick one run club, one film series or one bar trivia night and show up for a month.

slides.h: Pick plans with something to do
slides.box: Small talk is easier with a task.
slides.body: A class, a screening, a dinner with a long table. You don’t have to carry the conversation alone.

slides.box: Distance is the real friendship killer here.
slides.body: Make Tuesday plans in your own neighborhood. Save the cross-town trips for the weekend.
Happy hour beats “let’s get dinner sometime” every time.

slides.box: Four people and a pot of pasta counts.
slides.body: Invite two people you like who don’t know each other yet. Watch what happens.

end.box: Picks for every night at haps.club
end.body: Send this to the friend you keep saying you’ll see.

carousels.title: The perfect Sunday in Los Angeles

slides.box: The good peaches are gone by 11.
slides.body: Get coffee, walk the stalls, buy flowers you don’t need.
Park once. Walk everywhere. Lunch, a bookstore and a long way back to the car.

slides.box: A museum, a garden, a matinee in the park.
slides.body: Plenty of the city’s best afternoons cost nothing but the parking.

slides.box: Golden hour is the main event.
slides.body: Griffith Park, the beach or any rooftop with a view west.
Book a 6 PM table. Nobody is ever mad about a 6 PM table.

end.body: Send this to your Sunday person.

carousels.title: The holidays in Los Angeles, done right
carousels.sub: Even if your family is 3,000 miles away.

slides.box: Everyone brings one dish. No one brings a fruit tray.
slides.body: Ask who’s staying in town. You’ll be surprised how many people say yes.

slides.box: The city goes all in on light shows.
slides.body: Descanso, the Zoo and a dozen tree lightings. Pick one and bring a thermos.

slides.box: A holiday menu with your favorite person.
slides.body: Make the reservation now. December tables go fast.

slides.box: Concerts, ballet, a movie with a live orchestra.
slides.body: Nothing feels more like the season than a full room singing along.

slides.box: Beach walk on Christmas morning. Why not.
slides.body: Seventy degrees in December is a gift. Use it.

end.box: Every light show and dinner at haps.club
end.body: Tag the friend you’re spending the holidays with.
